reviews.title: Thanks for the 1 month trial
reviews.text:
I thought this was just what I needed but I am looking for an enhance and Unblur app with a bit of control .
I found it too much of both on numerous scanned negatives. 
They were mostly people , family and friends and the features in this app seemed to change the faces appearance far too much it didn’t look like them .
It was OK for landscapes but again a bit too much .
Perhaps I am asking for something that can’t be done by AI ?
Compared to many others this is one of the best for the price though .
And at last the idea of a trial is very welcome so you can find out rather than being forced to pay right from Day 1 .
Perhaps the Developer can explain why you can’t reduce the effect somehow .

The Colorize is not up to speed. I will delete this app and try another.
